posts.cooked:
I took notes this time! :D

Where's the art everyone's referencing for the new SHS? c.c

Doing without a gimmick? Do you know what podcast this is?

I'm impressed by how much of an impression Princess Cool has made on not just Christopher and Adam, but the entire Letters Page community. XD

I hear "luck antenna" and all I can think of is Xtreme Apostate's blood antenna, and I really have no idea where my mind is going with this but it is going.

Re-Volt didn't get a "shut up": This reinforces my idea that he is a precious (evil) cinnamon roll who must be protected at any cost. Seriously, I feel really bad for him, for all that I'm sure he deserves at least a modicum of pain for all the pain he's caused others.

posts.cooked:
The Shaughterlouse Six!

That bit about never-completed roleplaying sessions really gets me in the feels. When OblivAeon grants me the terrible burden of power, I’ll be using it to travel through time and complete all the plans that have ever been imagined, so that the cosmos can be destroyed in the sense of being totally complete, with nothing else remaining to be done.

This is like the fifth episode about RPG stuff. Besides Daybreak, there were also Helfyre, Perestroika and Timeslinger.

Any excuse to have Khatchaturian run through my head is a good one…

I love the idea that Ray Manta believes the true OblivAeon is Roko’s Basilisk. He probably read IHNMAIMS at a formative age.

As a huge fan of KVJ, I have great trouble taking the gag about him in stride.

Since the only connection point between the two teams named For Profit is the presence of Heartbreaker, he must have been the one to suggest the team’s name.

I’m sure Clockwork Cthulhu create Chaos frequently, but did the Chaos Clockwork create Cthulhu?

I think Glamour must be autistic, because she used to be the (Sh)REEEEiker. That’s how she got in touch with REEEEvocorp.
